subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Exaggerate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Understate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exaggerate"** means to describe something as larger or greater than it really is; to overstate. (अतिरंजित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tends to exaggerate the size of his accomplishments.
 
 
 
• **"Understate"** means to describe something as less important or smaller than it actually is; to downplay. (कम करके बताना)
 
 
• **Example: **She chose to understate the risks involved in the project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Understate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Emphasise **(जोर देना): To give special importance or prominence to something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher emphasised the importance of completing homework on time.
 
 
 
• **Embellish **(सजाना): To make something more attractive by adding decorative details.
 
 
• **Example: **He embellished his story with interesting anecdotes.
 
 
 
• **Neglect** (अवहेलना करना): To fail to care for properly.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt neglected when her parents paid more attention to her younger brother.
